Met VISplanner zie je direct op de kaart waar je wel en niet mag vissen. Er is uitgebreide informatie over het water beschikbaar. Deze app is als het ware een interactieve versie van de papieren Lijst van Viswateren. De combinatie van de VISplanner met de VISpas wettelijk geldig als schriftelijke toestemming.

Door in te loggen met je MijnSportvisserij-account worden je actieve visdocumenten opgehaald en de wateren waar je mag vissen blauw gekleurd (zie legenda voor meer informatie). 
Ook kan je via GPS zien wat jouw locatie is en met welke voorwaarden je in de wateren in de buurt mag vissen.

Bugs en problemen lossen we graag op. Mail dan een uitgebreide beschrijving van het probleem met je telefoonnummer en het type telefoon wat je gebruikt naar visplanner@sportvisserijnederland.nl.

The application is dedicated for users of the ProTrainUp system. The application can be used by the owners of the academy, as well as coordinators, coaches, players and their parents. The application gives  the opportunity to manage the work of the academy through a club calendar, control the status of premium payments, attendance control and  simple and effective communication between all users of the club. What's more, from the application level, the trainer has the ability to plan a traning, match or check attendance.

Thanks to the application you will not miss the most important matters. Straight on the phone you will receive notifications, among other things
• activities in the locker room (eg trainer messages),
• club messages
• appointment for a match
• vocation for training

Application functionalities

Manager
• Club calendar - training control and adding club events,
• Club advertising - the ability to send a message to all users - if you integrate a website with the ProTrainUp system, this feature allows you to add posts directly to the website,
• Club board - sharing materials and other content to the coaching staff,
• Management of teams, players and coaching staff,
• Messenger - communication via private messages.

Coach
• Team calendar - adding matches, training or other types of events,
• Presence - checking attendance at trainings,
• Locker-room - sharing materials and other content to players and parents,
• Matches - adding matches, fixing the match composition and completing match results. The coach also has the ability to measure live possession of the ball and supplement live match statistics,
• Schedule - training planning and training draft preview,
• Messenger - communication via private messages and group conversations,
• Contributions - checking the payment status.

Player / Parent
• Private calendar - access to all events related to a given player,
• Statistics - preview of own match statistics and attendance,
• Matches - access to the league table, timetable and match statistics,
• Class schedule - preview of the schedule,
• Messenger - communication via private messages and group conversations,
• Contributions - check the balance of premiums and the possibility to pay for the premium through the application.
